## Scope check

The engine is deliberately **brand-neutral**. Branding, logos and
company-specific decks belong in a wrapper repo (see the README section
"Using an External Theme Directory"). Requests to bundle a specific brand
will be declined — but if the current hooks make that awkward, say so,
that is a legitimate engine issue.
